home.hero.title: Build AI SaaS faster. Run it cheaper. Ship it production-grade.
home.hero.subtitle: OPCStack is a Cloudflare-native SaaS / AI product skeleton for One Person Company. It wires up auth, payments, credits, D1 sharding, R2, queues, cron, AI tasks and deployment automation, so you launch faster, run cheaper, and keep the architecture boundaries a real product needs
home.loop.title: Not a login page template, a production-ready base
home.loop.subtitle: These modules are wired around a real product flow, not isolated demos
home.cost.title: Low cost is not a slogan, it is the deploy target
home.cost.subtitle: A One Person Company should not spend time on servers, object storage, queues, CDN and autoscaling
home.cost.workers: Workers run Web SSR and Hono API
home.cost.r2: R2 stores uploads and AI output
home.diff.title: Many Cloudflare templates, few production skeletons
home.diff.subtitle: Other templates are built for demos, OPCStack is built to ship SaaS
home.diff.r1.opcstack: Meta DB + Tenant Shard DB layering
home.diff.r2.opcstack: Sign up, credits, payment, notification, feedback loop
home.diff.r3.opcstack: R2 public / private / tmp path conventions
home.diff.r4.opcstack: Queue + Tenant DB + R2 async task pipeline
home.diff.r6.opcstack: Architecture, constraints, tests and agent context first
home.steps.title: Three steps, no guessing
home.steps.subtitle: README stays an entry point, init details go to the agent
home.steps.s1.title: Clone the repo
home.steps.s1.desc: git clone, change remote to your repo, pnpm install
home.steps.s2.title: Agent-guided init
home.steps.s2.desc: @AGENTS.md @BOOTSTRAP.md, the agent confirms and runs config step by step
home.steps.s3.title: Run or deploy
home.steps.s3.desc: pnpm dev for local, pnpm deploy:cloudflare for the edge
home.faq.title: Things you might ask
home.faq.q1: Is OPCStack a template or a framework
home.faq.a1: It is a production-grade skeleton template. You clone and own the full code, delete what you do not need, but never redesign the base flow from zero
home.faq.q2: Can I remove modules I do not need
home.faq.a2: Yes. Modules collaborate through explicit interfaces, removing payment or AI does not break auth or storage
home.faq.a3: Workers, D1, R2, KV, Queues, Cron and CDN live on one edge platform, no spend when traffic is low, the platform absorbs traffic when it grows
home.faq.a4: A single D1 has a capacity ceiling. Meta DB holds global control state, tenant data goes to regional shards, new users auto-assigned, existing users never migrate
home.faq.q5: What do I need for local dev
home.faq.a5: Node and pnpm. Configure .env.dev and .env.secret.dev then pnpm dev, Cloudflare resources are auto-provisioned by prepare-cloudflare
home.faq.q6: Does it work for non-AI SaaS
home.faq.a6: Yes. AI is an optional module, remove it and auth, payment, credits, storage, queues and deploy skeleton stay complete
home.faq.q7: Is there a full admin dashboard
home.faq.a7: Not yet. OPCStack prioritizes the product base loop and Cloudflare deploy skeleton, the admin dashboard will be built around real operational needs
home.final.title: Lock the base down, then build your business
home.final.subtitle: Auth, payment, credits, storage, queues, AI tasks and deploy are already wired, what remains is your product
home.seo.title: OPCStack - Production-grade AI SaaS, built faster, run cheaper
home.seo.description: OPCStack is a Cloudflare-native SaaS / AI product skeleton for One Person Company, with auth, payments, credits, D1 sharding, R2, queues, cron, AI tasks and deployment automation built in, so AI SaaS launches faster, runs cheaper, and stays close to production-grade architecture
designSystem.title: Design System
designSystem.description: Every component, every token, every pattern — live and interactive
designSystem.s1.title: Tokens, type, surface
designSystem.s1.desc: The rule is monochrome and quiet. Every interactive element resolves to one ink color; every surface is either pure white, parchment off-white, or near-black
designSystem.s1.b.surfaces.desc: Daytime canvases. Tile alternation is the divider
designSystem.s1.b.ink.desc: A single primary carries every signal
designSystem.s2.title: One ink. Two grammars
designSystem.s2.desc: The pill carries every primary action. The square utility carries every chrome action. Active state is always scale(0.95)
designSystem.s3.title: Inputs that disappear into the page
designSystem.s3.desc: A single height, a single radius, a single border tone. Validation state lives on the surface, never on a shadow
designSystem.s4.title: Surface, signal, structure
designSystem.s4.desc: Cards carry content. Badges carry state. Tables carry data. Nothing competes with the product
designSystem.s4.b.card.desc: Header, title, description, action, content, footer
designSystem.s4.b.item.desc: Media, header, title, description, actions, separator, group
designSystem.s5.title: Wayfinding without noise
designSystem.s5.desc: Tabs, breadcrumbs, pagination, menus — all monochrome, all quiet
designSystem.s6.title: Layers that float, not intrude
designSystem.s6.desc: Dialogs, sheets, drawers, popovers, tooltips — all animate in, all respect the monochrome rule
designSystem.s7.title: Reveal on demand
designSystem.s7.desc: Accordion, collapsible, resizable panes, carousel, calendar — all controlled, all accessible
designSystem.s8.title: Business-layer building blocks
designSystem.s8.desc: Auth cards, header, menus, date filter — the components that ship with OPC Stack out of the box
